One course, one term, transport disruptions occur.
Attendance office has limited weekly request capacity.
Eligibility checked at a set point in term.

assumptions.statement: Request with any invalid class is refused whole.
Office can approve part of a request.
Office approves if covered classes are recorded absences.
Office can process 5 requests per week.
Commuter has 60 min slack, resident 15, working 30, family 20.
Stress variant 'Early checkpoint with many disruptions': checkpoint_week 10 -> 6
Stress variant 'Early checkpoint with many disruptions': Early eligibility check before all exceptions can be processed, penalizing students for late-week disruptions.

blueprint.weak_point: Early eligibility check before all exceptions can be processed, penalizing students for late-week disruptions.

policy.text: Students must maintain at least 80% attendance in each course to be eligible for examinations. Exceptional circumstances may be considered through formally approved exceptions.
policy.purpose: Improve class participation, encourage consistent attendance and maintain academic standards.
policy.environment: One institution and one course over a term. Students include a long-distance commuter, a resident student, a student with fixed work hours and a student with family responsibilities. Faculty, an academic advisor, an attendance administrator and an examination officer are involved. Transport disruptions happen during the term. The attendance office can process only a few exception requests a week, and eligibility is checked at a set point in the term.
